methodology: Solved from two AWS EC2 on-demand list prices (us-east-1) with different vCPU:memory ratios: c6i.large (2 vCPU / 4 GiB) at $0.085/hr and r6i.large (2 vCPU / 16 GiB) at $0.126/hr. Cross-checked against m6i.large (2 vCPU / 8 GiB, $0.096/hr actual vs ~$0.099/hr predicted by this rate) — within ~3%. AWS does not sell vCPU/memory separately for EC2, so this split is an approximation, not an official per-unit rate.
